candidates.title: GroupKV: Hierarchical KV Cache Management for Long-Context Diffusion LLM Inference
candidates.reason: dLLM向けhierarchical KV cacheでgroup-level sparse selection、cross-layer predictive prefetch、staleness correction、streaming prefillを統合。offload環境で最大3.73x、serviceable context最大48x。

candidates.title: Cache-Resident LLM Inference in GB-Scale Last-Level Caches
candidates.reason: GB級CPU LLCへweightをresident化しattention/KV domainを分離するhierarchical-memory execution model。multi-socket prototypeでllama.cpp比TPOT 2.04-11.51x。

candidates.title: Harvest: Opportunistic Peer-to-Peer GPU Caching for LLM Inference
candidates.reason: unused peer GPU memoryをtransient cache tierとしてexpert weights/KVを配置しhost offloadを回避するGPU P2P cache framework。dynamic memory availability下で2x超throughput改善を報告。
